summary: Iteration 2 (Precios Actual schema v2) - Full backend + frontend regression. 49/49 pytest tests pass. New: quick filters (rin, marca, combined), /api/products/facets, /api/favorites (add/list/delete + per-user isolation + dedupe + rin included). RBAC verified with EXACT column letter mapping: caracas=[I,J,K], oriente_sur=[L,M,N], oriente_norte=[O,P,Q], panofre=[R,S], tires_center=[AE,AF,AG] (NEVER OTROS AC/AD), master=20. Admin dashboard confirms worksheet='Precios Actual', connection_ready=false, missing_setup contains MS_TENANT_ID/MS_CLIENT_ID/MS_CLIENT_SECRET, /api/admin/sync source='mock' with row_count>0. All /api/* endpoints correctly 401 without token; /api/admin/* correctly 403 for the 5 non-master roles. History still capped at 6, deduped, per-user. Refresh works for all 6 roles. Frontend E2E (390x844 mobile viewport) passes: Caracas login -> RIN + MARCA chip rows render horizontally, tapping rin-chip-16 filters to 13 results all RIN 16, opening product shows exactly 3 tiles (CARACAS_BS/CASH/ZELLE), Favorito tile toggles to 'Guardado', Compartir (WhatsApp) button present, Buscar otro + Nueva consulta navigate correctly, logout works. Master login -> Panel Admin shows 'Conexión OneDrive pendiente' banner, worksheet 'Precios Actual', sync button works (mock reseed).
action_items: No functional fixes required. Consider optional UX: 'Buscar otro' currently preserves the RIN/MARCA filter on home, which hides the Favoritos section until the user taps X on the filter or 'Nueva consulta'. Product decision - not a bug. Nueva consulta correctly resets state.
Optional: expose a small toast/confirmation when a favorite is added (current UI relies on the label change 'Favorito' -> 'Guardado').
critical_code_review_comments: schema.py cleanly locks the column letter map at module level. PRICE_COLUMNS length is 20, ROLE_COLUMN_MAP correctly excludes OTROS from tires_center.
server.py: /api/products/facets is declared BEFORE /api/products/{sku} - correct route ordering (verified working, 200 with token, 401 without).
authorized_columns() is the single source of truth server-side; direct SKU URL access with a non-master token never leaks unauthorized columns (parametrized test across 5 roles x 5 SKUs).
onedrive_service.py: is_configured() gates fetch_rows()->None fallback; sync() cleanly returns source='mock' when MS_* env vars are unset; sync exception path is wrapped in 502.
Startup schema_version='precios-actual-v2' triggers a reseed on stale mock - verified 46 products present with correct 20-column price payload.
Auto-refresh loop uses asyncio.create_task and is a no-op without MS creds (safe).
Favorites endpoint dedupes by SKU with $pull+$push and includes rin from the product doc (verified in list response).
seed_data_creation: None. Used the 46 pre-seeded mock products and the 6 seeded users. Test-created favorites/history are self-contained per user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL=https://venege-precios.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend tests: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend testIDs to reuse: username-input, password-input, login-submit-button, search-input, rin-filter-row, rin-chip-{n}, marca-filter-row, marca-chip-{name}, suggestion-{sku}, product-identity, price-tile-{KEY}, favorite-toggle, share-quotation, buscar-otro-button, nueva-consulta-button, favorites-list, favorite-{sku}, history-list, history-{sku}, header-logout, master-panel-link, sync-button, sync-card. MS_* env vars are intentionally empty; admin/sync source must remain 'mock'.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found this iteration.
